description_en: Queries the global routing protocol of an SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G device whose version is 3.4.2 or later
description_zh: 获取SAG设备全局路由协议，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
kebab_example: aliyun smartag view-smart-access-gateway-global-route-protocol --sag-ins-id sag-iv408aov6k7xxm0000 --sag-sn sagf4ea0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cross-account false --resource-uid 1097906206970000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ViewSmartAccessGatewayGlobalRouteProtocol

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
parameters.name: sag_ins_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the SAG instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

- **false**（默认值）：否。

- **true**：是
